content: Hello, I am Varsha Jarali. I have completed Ph.D in Mathematics. I am currently working on a project focused on the "formal verification of cryptographic protocols". As part of this work, we use tools such as ProVerif, CryptoVerif for protocol and implementation-level verification. In addition, we are thinking to explore the use of Lean4 to formally prove the correctness of cryptographic operations and to extract verified implementations for further use. I am searching post doc position to do further research on formal verification of cryptographic protocols and also on designing light weight cryptosystem.
